name: ETH3D
description: A multi-view stereo benchmark with high-resolution images and multi-camera videos, covering diverse indoor and outdoor scenes with laser-scanned ground truth.
citation: Schöps, T., Schönberger, J. L., Galliani, S., Sattler, T., Schindler, K., Pollefeys, M., and Geiger, A. (2017). A Multi-View Stereo Benchmark With High-Resolution Images and Multi-Camera Videos. Proceedings of the IEEE Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR), 3260–3269. https://doi.org/10.1109/CVPR.2017.369
